about: Runs that were really measured on the PCs listed, copied from the records named in each example's source. Nothing here is estimated or rounded. A figure the record does not give is written as null and said in the caveat. To add one, add an object with the same fields (hardware for every PC, model, settings, result, date, source).

examples.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash in the app, the Z820 lending (Max mode)

hardware.pc: HP Z240 (this PC, loads the model)
HP 800 G1 (set to Don't borrow, not used)

settings.cluster: no saved cluster: the app's Max mode borrowing (TOMLIN 2.0.94)
settings.maxMode: on, with the Z820 as the only lender; the HP 800 set to Don't borrow
settings.layout: experts 0-96 here, 97-255 on the Z820, 22 layers on the card, batch 32, models on a hard disk at about 86 MB/s

result.what: first request 1.41 tokens a second writing (later requests 1.01 and 1.40); ready after 1,128 s

examples.caveat: Three requests of 40 to 48 words at temperature 0. Against 1.84 for the same layout in the test run (llama-bench): the gap was not separated (22 against 30 layers on the card, the app's encryption, threads, a cold first request). The 1,128 s load estimate was first 868 s.

examples.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash in the app with three PCs: failed

hardware.pc: HP Z240 (this PC, loads the model)

settings.cluster: no saved cluster: the app's Max mode borrowing (TOMLIN 2.0.94)
settings.maxMode: on, with the Z820 and the HP 800 as lenders
settings.layout: experts 0-81 here, 82-110 and 111-255 on the lenders

result.what: no speed: the load failed twice (died at 846 s with 'Remote RPC server crashed or returned malformed response'; died at 1,138 s with 'send failed' after a lender's stream went quiet at 6 minutes)

examples.caveat: The HP 800 is the likely cause of the second failure. Three PCs together were not stable at this date: two worked.

examples.title: A 24B model on two cards against three cards (test run)

model.name: a 23.57 B dense model (the result file does not name it)

settings.cluster: not the app: a test run through the cluster test door, encrypted ('sealed')
settings.maxMode: not used (test run, not the app)
settings.layout: two cards P2000/3060 = 9/32 layers; three cards = 9/31/1 layers

result.what: three cards, 8.69 tokens a second writing (plus or minus 1.49); the same model on two cards gave 12.15 (plus or minus 0.29); a 9/30/2 split on three cards gave 4.20

examples.caveat: Adding the third PC made it slower, not faster. The model's file name is not recorded in the result file. Load time was not recorded.

examples.title: Qwen3.5-35B on the Z240 with the Z820's card lending (Max mode)

settings.cluster: no saved cluster: Max mode, a throwaway TOMLIN on another port

result.what: 5.7 tokens a second writing, 403 reading; the Z240 alone gave 11.4 (12.8 tuned) in the speed chart

examples.caveat: The lender raised reading about four times (101 to 403) but writing stayed 5 to 6, far below the host alone: Max mode is not a speed feature for a model that fits one PC.

examples.title: Qwen3-Next-80B on the Z240 with the HP 800 lending (Max mode)

settings.cluster: no saved cluster: Max mode split (TOMLIN 2.0.71)

result.what: 4.6 tokens a second writing; the Z240 alone gave 10.9

examples.caveat: Slower than the host alone for every model that fits on it. Load time was not recorded.

examples.title: Qwen3-Next-80B on the Z820 alone (cluster off)

settings.layout: default offload: 49/49 layers offloaded with part of the file held in RAM

result.what: median of 14 answers in a 5 minute run (8.53 to 9.15); the first answer, which loads the model, took 127 s

examples.caveat: The same PC with no card (CPU only) gave 3.39 tokens a second.

examples.title: Qwen3-Next-80B on the Z820 alone, no card (cluster off)

settings.layout: Run on CPU, 0 of 41 layers on a card, context 8,192

result.what: median of 6 answers in a 5 minute run (3.30 to 3.39); load and warm-up 90 s

examples.caveat: Usable for one-off work, slow for chat.
